chapters.title: Private DNS and virtual network links

takeaways: Azure DNS is a managed hosting service for DNS zones, so you no longer run, patch or scale your own DNS servers.
Public zones serve names to the internet and require delegation at your registrar, while private zones resolve only inside the virtual networks you link to them.
Use alias records for Azure resources and recreate every existing record in Azure before switching name servers to avoid outages.
hook: Everyone uses DNS, but few people understand the chain behind a lookup or how Azure takes over the job. This episode explains Azure DNS for cloud admins and beginners: public and private zones, the record types you actually need, delegation and virtual network links. You will know how to move a domain to Azure DNS without breaking your website or email.
